note: Advanced settings from the OMEN page to AFO_r1 (run 15). Packet accepted only with magic and version; each field taken only if valid, else the value in use is kept. Held forever, no timeout. Values in use are echoed on 5433 columns 18-28 in this order, 29 adv_seq, 30 spring_stiffness, 44 standstill_fade_ms, 45 assist_ramp_step.

fields.name: sv_target_min
fields.rule: 0.2..2.0 and < sv_target_max in use after this packet, else min and max both keep

fields.name: torque_p_gain
fields.rule: 0.05..3 (default 0.45); else keep; takes effect at once

fields.name: torque_i_gain
fields.rule: 0..5 (default 0.55); else keep; takes effect at once, a change resets the PI integrator for one step

fields.name: assist_ramp_step
fields.rule: 0..10 (default 1); 0 = no ramp; assistance rises by this much per heel strike after Assist ON; else keep

fields.name: standstill_fade_ms
fields.rule: 0..1000 (default 200); torque fades out/in over this time when the standing-still cutoff engages/releases; 0 = hard cut as before; else keep
